source_text: These effects arise causally from acute pain, loss of bodily autonomy, and cultural stigmatization, with severity correlating to procedural invasiveness, though even Type I cases show adjusted odds ratios of 1.5-2.0 for mood disorders relative to non-mutilated peers. [102]
